verdict.rationale: Raygun documents several of the trend views the story asks for. Its changelog adds an error chart to the search results page "for visual insight into error frequency and trends" (volume over time). It ranks errors by users affected and occurrence count, and filters by date and version. It also tracks deployments "to identify any new errors or regressions" (new issues per release). However, nothing shows a leadership dashboard that aggregates trends across multiple projects and teams; the evidence is per-application views and search charts. missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregated dashboards, an explicit top-regressions view, detailed docs on per-release new-issue reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
